en: A unit of weight equal to about 454 grams; or the unit of money used in Britain; or to hit something hard and repeatedly.
ex: She bought two pounds of apples at the market.
她在市場買了兩磅蘋果。

en: Having great strength, force or influence; or very effective; or able to affect people's lives.
ex: The powerful storm destroyed many houses along the coast.
強烈的暴風雨摧毀了沿海的許多房屋。

en: To speak to God or a god in order to give thanks or ask for help; or to ask someone urgently for something.
ex: The villagers prayed for rain during the long drought.
在長期乾旱中，村民們為下雨而祈禱。

en: To like one thing or person more than another; or to choose something as better.
ph: 喜歡 A 勝過 B
ex: I prefer coffee to tea in the morning.
早上我喜歡咖啡勝過茶。

en: To push something with your hand or finger; or newspapers and journalists in general; or a machine for printing.
ex: Press the red button to start the machine.
按下紅色按鈕來啟動機器。

en: The force that you feel when you are pressed; or a strong feeling of worry or demand; or to force someone to do something.
ex: Students often feel pressure before important exams.
學生在重要考試前常感到壓力。

en: A feeling of satisfaction about something you have done; or too high an opinion of yourself; or to be proud of something.
ex: She takes great pride in her garden.
她對自己的花園感到十分自豪。

en: A person who is trained to perform religious duties in a church or temple.
ex: The priest gave a sermon at the church on Sunday.
神父星期天在教堂佈道。

en: The most important; or the first or earliest in order or time; or relating to the first stage of education.
ex: The primary reason for her success is hard work.
她成功的主要原因是努力工作。

en: The son of a king or queen; or the daughter of a king or queen (princess).
ex: In the fairy tale, the prince saved the princess.
在童話故事裡，王子救了公主。

en: The person in charge of a school; or main or most important; or an amount of money borrowed or invested.
ex: The principal gave a speech to all the students.
校長對全體學生發表了演說。

en: A basic rule or idea that guides how you behave; or a scientific law that explains how something works.
ex: He refused the money on principle.
他基於原則拒絕了那筆錢。

en: To produce words or pictures on paper using a machine; or to write in separate letters; or a mark left on a surface.
ex: Please print the document and bring it to class.
請把這份文件印出來帶到課堂上。

en: A machine that prints documents from a computer; or a person or company that prints books or papers.
col: the printer is out of paper
ex: The printer ran out of paper, so I added some.
印表機沒紙了，所以我補了些。

en: A building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime; or the state of being kept in such a place.
ex: He was sent to prison for three years for stealing.
他因偷竊被判入獄三年。

en: A person who is kept in a prison; or a person who is held by an enemy.
ex: The prisoner escaped from the jail during the night.
囚犯在夜裡從監獄逃走了。

en: To make or grow something, often in large quantities; or to cause something to happen; or fruit and vegetables.
ex: The factory produces thousands of cars every year.
這座工廠每年生產數千輛汽車。

en: The process of making or growing goods; or the total amount of something made; or a play or film.
ex: The production of the new car will begin next month.
這款新車將於下個月開始生產。

en: The process of improving or getting closer to achieving something; or to move forward or develop.
ex: She is making good progress in her English studies.
她的英語學習進步得很好。

en: A piece of work that is planned and done to achieve a particular result; or a school assignment; or to show a film on a screen.
ex: The students are working on a science project.
學生們正在做一個科學專題。

en: A statement that you will certainly do something; or to say that you will definitely do something; or signs of future success.
ex: She promised to call me as soon as she arrived.
她答應一到就打電話給我。

en: Right or suitable for a particular purpose or situation; or correct and acceptable.
ex: You should wear proper shoes when you go hiking.
去健行時你應該穿合適的鞋子。

en: To suggest something as a plan or idea; or to ask someone to marry you.
ex: He proposed to her on a beach at sunset.
他在日落時的海灘向她求婚。

en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or danger.
ex: Sunscreen helps to protect your skin from the sun.
防曬乳有助於保護你的皮膚免受日曬。

en: To show that something is true by giving facts; or to be shown to be true; or to turn out to be.
ex: The scientist proved that the earth goes around the sun.
科學家證明了地球繞著太陽轉。

en: To give someone something that they need or want; or to supply something; or to make arrangements.
ex: The hotel provides free breakfast for all guests.
這家飯店為所有房客提供免費早餐。

en: A large, round orange vegetable with a thick skin that is used for making pies and lanterns at Halloween.
ex: We carved a face on the pumpkin for Halloween.
我們在南瓜上刻了一張臉，慶祝萬聖節。

en: To make someone suffer because they have done something wrong; or a penalty given for breaking a rule.
ex: The teacher punished the boy for cheating on the test.
老師因為那個男孩考試作弊而處罰了他。

en: A young dog.
ex: The little puppy followed the girl everywhere.
小狗到處跟著那個女孩。

en: A color between red and blue; or having this color.
ex: The sky turned purple and orange as the sun set.
日落時，天空變成了紫色和橘色。

en: The reason for which something is done or created; or the aim of something; or to intend.
ex: The purpose of the meeting is to discuss next year's plans.
這場會議的目的是討論明年的計畫。

en: A game or toy that you have to put together or solve; or a difficult problem; or to confuse someone.
ex: The children spent the afternoon doing a jigsaw puzzle.
孩子們下午都在拼拼圖。

en: How good or bad something is; or a feature of a person or thing; or of a high standard.
ex: This shop sells good quality clothes at fair prices.
這家店以合理的價格販售品質好的衣服。

en: The amount or number of something; or a large amount of something.
ex: She bought a large quantity of rice at the market.
她在市場買了大量的米。

en: A short test to check knowledge; or a game in which people answer questions; or to ask someone questions.
ex: The teacher gave us a short quiz on the last chapter.
老師給了我們一次關於上一章的小考。

en: A system of tracks along which trains run; or the company that operates trains.
ex: The railway runs along the coast for fifty miles.
這條鐵路沿著海岸延伸了五十英里。

en: A waterproof coat that you wear to keep dry in the rain.
ex: It started to rain, so she put on her raincoat.
開始下雨了，所以她穿上雨衣。

en: A set of different things of the same general type; or the area that something covers; or a line of mountains.
ex: The shop sells a wide range of electronic products.
這家店販售各式各樣的電子產品。

en: Happening or moving very quickly; or a fast-moving part of a river (rapids).
ex: The city has experienced rapid growth in recent years.
這座城市近年來經歷了快速的成長。

en: Not common and so valuable or interesting; or (of meat) cooked for a short time so that the inside is still red.
ex: It is rare to see snow in this part of the country.
在這個國家的這個地區很少看到雪。
